newsitem.title: USA: DNA results from Ramsey case sent to officials.
newsitem.headline: DNA results from Ramsey case sent to officials.

text.p: Critical DNA test results in the investigation into the murder of 6-year-old JonBenet Ramsey have been delivered to police, officials said on Thursday.
However, police in Boulder declined to disclose any details from the test results received from Cellmark Diagnostics in Germantown, Maryland.
Police also said they are still awaiting a fifth handwriting sample from the girl's mother Patricia Ramsey.

Authorities have declined to disclose what type of samples were sent in March to Cellmark for testing, although published reports have said the samples were believed to include hair and fingernail scrapings.

No arrests have been made and no suspects named in the four-month-old investigation into the murder of JonBenet, who was a beauty pageant winner. Her body was found on Dec. 26 by her father in the basement of the family home some eight hours after her mother said she found a ransom note demanding $118,000.
